name: byeol-suite
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @byeol/i18n && npm run test -w @byeol/electron-utils && npm run test -w @byeol/docx-engine && npm run test -w @byeol/file-parse && npm run test -w @byeol/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @byeol/pptx-render && npm run test -w @byeol/ai-search && npm run test -w @byeol/agent-core && npm run test -w @byeol/ai-provider && npm run test -w @byeol/project-store && npm run test -w @byeol/docs && npm run test -w @byeol/sheets && npm run test -w @byeol/shell && npm run test -w @byeol/slides && npm run test -w @byeol/pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @byeol/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/ui && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/docs && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/shell && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/slides && npm run typecheck -w @byeol/pdf
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,magenta "DOCS_DEV_PORT=15173 npm run dev:renderer -w @byeol/docs" "SHEETS_DEV_PORT=15174 npm run dev:renderer -w @byeol/sheets" "SLIDES_DEV_PORT=15175 npm run dev:renderer -w @byeol/slides" "PDF_DEV_PORT=15176 npm run dev:renderer -w @byeol/pdf" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:15173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:15174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:15175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:15176 npm run dev -w @byeol/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @byeol/docs && npm run build -w @byeol/sheets && npm run build -w @byeol/slides && npm run build -w @byeol/pdf && npm run build -w @byeol/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:mac -w @byeol/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @byeol/shell
